_README: Pre-existing DB column/table references that do not resolve against database/schema/mysql-schema.sql. Read by scripts/check-db-column-references.mjs. SHRINK-ONLY: removing an entry is what a fix looks like; the gate FAILS if a listed entry no longer occurs, so a fix cannot land without updating this file. Adding an entry needs a reason in the commit message. Seeded 2026-07-30 when the gate was written.
_WHY: A documentation audit found docs citing a `group_bans` table that never existed. Chasing it down found the same defect three more times in the same service as a COLUMN mismatch on a table that does exist (writes to updated_at / moderated_at / action_taken on group_content_flags, whose real columns are resolved_at and moderation_action). Every write threw, and it went unnoticed for four months because each method wrapped its body in catch (\Throwable) and returned a plausible value. Provenance: commit de2e48396 (2026-03-20, 'add missing service methods') wrote 15 services against an imagined schema.
_FIXED_2026_07_30: All three `live-defect` entries are gone, fixed rather than re-baselined, and every one resolved as 'the code is wrong, the schema is right'. consent_types.tenant_id: the table is a PLATFORM-GLOBAL catalogue keyed by slug and FK'd from tenant_consent_overrides + consent_version_history, with per-tenant customisation done through the override table — so the admin CRUD dropped tenant_id and its three mutations now require a PLATFORM super admin, because a shared catalogue means every write is cross-tenant. challenge_claims: never created; the real claim ledger is user_challenge_progress.reward_claimed, so ChallengeService::claim was reimplemented on it to match GamificationV2Controller (the old version also never awarded anything, so creating the table would have made a visible failure silent). match_preference_categories: never created, and the canonical match_preferences.categories JSON column already persists the choices, so the vestigial side-table blocks were deleted. Two `verified` entries went with them (match_history.score / .distance) when the dead MatchingService::recordInteraction duplicate was removed. Regression cover: tests/Laravel/Feature/SchemaWriteRegressionTest.php FIX 7-9.

_STATUS_MEANINGS.live-defect: Reachable in production and the write throws. Fix these.
_STATUS_MEANINGS.verified: Real mismatch, but the code path has no callers — dead. Delete or repair as a cleanup, not an incident.
_STATUS_MEANINGS.unreachable: Real mismatch; triaged 2026-07-30 and confirmed to have no callers or no route, so nothing hits it today. Still wrong, still worth removing.

post_hashtags.tag.note: Dead code — syncTags has no callers. The ->delete() above the insert DOES succeed and is not tenant-scoped, so a future caller would clear a post's hashtag links and then fail to write the replacements.

deliverable_comments.content.note: Not routed and no internal caller. The whole deliverables feature appears unwired.

listings.approved_by.note: AdminListingsService is referenced only by AppServiceProvider (DI registration, not a call). AdminListingsController injects ListingModerationService — a different class.

comments.is_hidden.note: No ->applyDecision( call site anywhere in app/ outside the declaring file.

deliverables.project_id.note: Class referenced only by AppServiceProvider. Every ->create( hit in app/ resolves to a different service.

deliverable_comments.body.note: Same as deliverables.project_id. Note this file writes `body` while DeliverableController writes `content` — neither column exists.

exchange_requests.provider_notes.note: The only ->decline( call site is $this->hourGiftService->decline(...) — CaringHourGiftService, a different class.

user_skills.skill_id.note: No callers. The real column is skill_name; user_skills has no skill_id and no updated_at.

tenant_features.note: Not routed, no internal caller. Real feature toggling goes through TenantFeatureConfig and tenants.features.

api_tokens.note: No callers — the only ->refreshToken( site is AuthController::refreshToken(). Real tokens are TokenService JWTs.

cron_job_runs.note: Class referenced only by AppServiceProvider. Cron monitoring in use is CronJobRunner.

_TRIAGE: All entries triaged 2026-07-30 against the LIVE dev database via information_schema, not just the committed dump: every one is ABSENT live as well, so there is ZERO dump drift here and every entry is a code defect. Positive controls (users.email, group_content_flags.resolved_at, match_history.match_score, post_hashtags.hashtag_id, user_skills.skill_name) all returned present, so the query discriminates. The live DB has 727 tables against the dump's 723, so minor drift exists — just not in any of these. Reachability was then established per entry; a first pass using bare method names was discarded because generic names like create() and run() matched hundreds of unrelated call sites.
